title: The two constant one-bit inputs differ
statement: Regarding the two Boolean-valued functions on the singleton index set $\mathrm{Fin}\,1 = \{0\}$, the constant function taking the value $\mathit{false}$ everywhere and the constant function taking the value $\mathit{true}$ everywhere are distinct.
hypotheses_covered: none (unconditional inequality of two explicit functions)
replaced:
The constant-$\mathit{false}$ and constant-$\mathit{true}$ inputs on $\mathrm{Fin}\,1$ are
distinct.
